name: code-reviewer
description: A staged workflow for modernizing, refactoring, or remediating an existing codebase, split into six skills: an orchestrator (code-reviewer) plus one per phase (intake, catalog, strategy, execute, validate). intake runs its own four-lens code review (security, standards, efficiency, infrastructure) directly, inline — code review is this plugin's own job, not delegated to the separate council plugin, which reviews documentation and plans instead, not code. catalog deduplicates and classifies findings; strategy builds a sequencing plan with the user (shared/infrastructure code first, business logic last); execute implements one stage at a time, running old and new code side by side when risky; validate is the human approval gate between stages. For the coding standard intake checks against, it depends on the sdsi plugin's /sdsi:sdsi when installed, falling back to a project-local SDSI.md otherwise.
